bhattar.cp: masc. a husband; one who support or brings up.

P: Bhattar，[Vedic bhartṛ to bhṛ] a husband; Nom．sg．bhattā Th．2，413; J．V，104，260 （here in meaning “supporter＂）; VI，492; Gen．bhattu J．V，169，170; Acc．bhattāraṁ Th．2，412．（Page 497）
DOP: 1 bhatta(r) m. [ S. bhaktṛ], a worshipper, devotee; Sadd 347, 31 (bhaja sevāyaṃ: … bhatti sambhatti ~ā).
